entries.body: The Forge How to Reach The Hill Our mascot, The OKHP³™ MurderBird, isn't a passenger pigeon, so don't expect it to deliver your message. But don't be shy, despite the menacing metallic appearance, we really do want to hear from you! Contact Contact For project inquiries, collaboration opportunities, or professional engagements, reach out directly: Email: contact@overkillhill.com Location: Operating remotely across U.S. Central Time For updates, news, and musings from the forge, follow OverKill Hill P³™ on social media.
